name: v3_video_2_gold_pour
prompt:
A hand picks up a small bottle of shimmering gold metallic paint and tilts it over the brown paint puddle.
A thick stream of brilliant gold paint pours out of the bottle onto the dark brown surface.
The gold paint splashes and pools on top of the brown, creating a bright contrast.
Slow deliberate pouring motion, the gold stream is thick and glossy.
Top-down flat lay, static camera, close-up.
